from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd(); out=root/"reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
protocol={
 "study_id":"510300_OFFICIAL_JOINT_CAUSE_FULL_ORIGINAL_POPULATION_V1",
 "experiment_id":"E59","registered_at":stamp,
 "parent_proposal":"reports/research/510300_service_construction_demand_cause_increment_v1/next_experiment.json",
 "status":"REGISTERED_FULL_ORIGINAL_MONTH_UNIVERSE_AND_EXISTING_OFFICIAL_CAUSE_EVIDENCE_BEFORE_NEW_TEXT_BINDING",
 "hypothesis":"原全部统计月份公开的共同原因可能区分相同宏观值的不同约束；先检验全原来源、作用层级和决定前信息，不从股市结果制造原因。",
 "population":"原1212评分日、各日完整原成熟训练成员和当前观察全部保持；按原orders_available_at唯一绑定132月原数据收件，反查统计月份，不自行指定两后验月份或新增四收益窗口。",
 "fixed_existing_official_roots":["reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1","reports/research/510300_equal_production_official_interpretation_source_v1"],
 "existing_months_claim_is_to_verify":"旧E38登记2024-01/02/03与E54两月，不把登记月份当成功原件；实际有效来源数与文章层级以原收件为准。",
 "causal_evidence_contract":{"explicit_joint_reason":"原文有明确作用对象、原因表述及共同限定语；保存整段上下文，不把相关行业/价格解释迁为整体PMI或生产原因。","context":"同文同期政策/海外/需求背景但未明确连接目标，不升级因果。","unknown":"原件缺、未给明确原因、公布晚于决定或首件未认证均各自保留UNKNOWN；未提及某原因不得编0/纯另一原因。","multiple_causes":"原理由可并存，不制作天气与关税互斥分类，不读取收益给原因打分。"},
 "source_inputs":["reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json","reports/research/510300_service_construction_demand_cause_increment_v1/原八字段与服务建筑订单两字段_未读标签.parquet","reports/research/510300_service_construction_demand_cause_increment_v1/全部132月原服务建筑订单绑定.json"],
 "clock":"原统计数据钟与官方解释公布钟分开，解释须不晚于每个原成员的decision_time；经济月/网页公布/本次收件/历史首件分开，显示钟准入不认证历史首版。",
 "budgets":{"network_requests":0,"new_fits":0,"new_return_labels":0,"full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0},
 "source_acquisition_followup":"只在实际母集和旧来源结果明确后，另登记不同完整原因用途的有限实际官方源路线，不自动86个月采集或重复E38固定失败。",
 "prior_frozen_rejections_preserved":["E38","E49","E51","E56","E33","E58"],
 "new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,"orders_authorized":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,
 "goal_turn_previous_classification":"PROGRESS_E53_CONTEXT_E54_OFFICIAL_CAUSES_E55_FULL_SOURCE_E56_FIXED_SCORE_E57_ATTRIBUTION_E58_SHARED_WEIGHT_POINTER_CLOSED",
 "root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0
}
(out/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
meta=[]
for rel in protocol["fixed_existing_official_roots"]:
 base=root/rel
 rec={"root":rel,"names":sorted(p.name for p in base.iterdir() if p.is_file()),"metadata":[]}
 for name in ["result.json","source_gate.json"]:
  f=base/name
  if f.exists():rec["metadata"].append({"path":str(f.relative_to(root)),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"value":json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))})
 meta.append(rec)
(out/"实际旧官方来源导航.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"protocol":str(out/"protocol.json"),"existing_metadata":meta},ensure_ascii=False))
